dependencyEvidence.source: Parent handoff on 2026-10-05; consumer source/path not independently inspected in this task.

credentialBoundary: No token, API key or raw secret in repository or handoff. ContentOps owns a separately authorized Nilaza-scoped credential boundary.

idempotency.authority: ContentOps atomic durable unique reservation, not this config or an empty local ledger
idempotency.secondaryCheck: Same video byte hash on same channel blocks a new content ID; explicit owner-reviewed reuse requires a fresh content decision.
idempotency.unknownResult: Persist original upload-session/video identifiers securely in ContentOps; reconcile read-only. Never issue another videos.insert blindly.

channelLock.before: Authenticate the Nilaza-owned grant; channels.list(mine=true) must resolve exactly the pinned channel.
channelLock.after: Require returned/retrieved snippet.channelId to match pinned ID before any schedule transition.
channelLock.mismatch: Halt, preserve receipt and notify Owner; no fallback to another channel.

youtubePreconditions.upload: private staging only after explicit approval; OAuth and API project audit capabilities must be verified separately.
youtubePreconditions.schedule: Never-published private video; future UTC publishAt with lead time. Past timestamp is blocked.
youtubePreconditions.tokenLifecycle: External Testing with YouTube scopes can issue seven-day refresh tokens; renew/re-authorize only through separately approved operator flow.
youtubePreconditions.quota: Read current project/quota capability; no static quota promise.
youtubePreconditions.receipt: ContentOps records video ID, snippet channel, processing status, metadata/artifact hashes and publishAt reconciliation; no inferred public success.

budgetBoundary: Atomic Nilaza YouTube-only reservation before every paid model/audio/render call; both week and per-video caps, retry budget and kill switch. No app API budget or Mây budget borrowing.
